title: Cities of the Levites

questions.question: Who approached Eleazar and Joshua to ask for their cities?
options: The heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: The heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:1 (ESV): "Then the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites came to Eleazar..."

questions.question: Why did the Levites receive cities?
options: Because the Lord commanded Moses that they be given cities to dwell in and pasturelands for cattle
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Lord commanded Moses that they be given cities to dwell in and pasturelands for cattle
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:2 (ESV): "...The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, along with their pasturelands..."

questions.question: How many cities in all did the Levites receive?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:41 (ESV): "The cities of the Levites... were in all forty-eight cities with their pasturelands."

questions.question: Which family of Levites received the first lot?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 (ESV): "The lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites."

questions.question: Did the Lord give Israel all the land he swore to give their fathers?
options: Yes, and they took possession of it and dwelt in it
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, and they took possession of it and dwelt in it
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:43 (ESV): "Thus the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their fathers. And they took possession of it..."

questions.question: Did any of the good promises causing the house of Israel to fail?
options: Not one word of all the good promises... had failed; all came to pass
questions.correctAnswer: Not one word of all the good promises... had failed; all came to pass
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:45 (ESV): "Not one word of all the good promises... had failed; all came to pass."

questions.question: From which tribes did the descendants of Aaron receive their cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 (ESV): "...allotted thirteen cities out of the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin."

questions.question: The Gershonites received cities from closest to which area?
options: Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan (North/East)
questions.correctAnswer: Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan (North/East)
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:6 (ESV): "...out of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan..."

questions.question: The Merarites received cities from which tribes?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:7 (ESV): "...out of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun..."

questions.question: What special type of cities were included in the Levitical cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:13 implies Hebron (a city of refuge) was given to Aaron's descendants, plus its pasturelands.

questions.question: Hebron was given to the priests, but who got the fields and villages of the city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:12 (ESV): "But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb... as his possession."

questions.question: How many cities did the Merarites receive?
How many cities did the Kohathites (non-priests) receive?
Did the Lord give them rest on every side?
options: Yes, just as he had sworn to their fathers
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, just as he had sworn to their fathers
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:44 (ESV): "And the Lord gave them rest on every side just as he had sworn to their fathers..."

questions.question: Who stood before them of all their enemies?
options: Not one of all their enemies had withstood them
questions.correctAnswer: Not one of all their enemies had withstood them
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:44 (ESV): "Not one of all their enemies had withstood them..."

key_verse_text: Not one word of all the good promises that the LORD had made to the house of Israel had failed; all came to pass. (ESV)
